as_told.title: Three-fingered being's touch and the download

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that in 2019, in his own room, "suddenly the roof like dissolves and I see the underside of a rectangular craft." He says gray beings were there, that a three-fingered being touched him, and that he then received a download of knowledge whose first thought was "that the universe is teeming with life." Prasad tells it as his own experience, and if true, it means he was contacted directly by non-human beings.
